title: Iterated contraction of uniform excess
statement: Let $G$ be a finite regular multigraph of positive degree $D$ with a nonempty vertex set. Suppose $c$ is a nonnegative rational number such that, for every rational-valued function $p$ on the vertices whose values sum to $1$, applying the $K$-step walk distribution to $p$ gives uniform excess at most $c$ times the uniform excess of $p$. Then for every nonnegative integer $i$ and every such function $p$, the distribution after $iK$ steps has uniform excess at most $c^i$ times the uniform excess of $p$.
hypotheses_covered: $G$ has a finite, nonempty vertex set
